integrity: The mean drift and parent model are attributed to Cleuren and Eichhorn (2026); the claim is limited to the novel complete one-cycle law and rare sign-error rate. Finite checks support but do not prove limits. No independent audit or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact dynamics and asymptotics assume one free colloid, full-rank symmetric body-frame mobility with isotropic positive translational Schur complement, a nonzero translation–rotation coupling, perfectly periodic angle-only reset, and fixed rotational variance per cycle; the weak-diffusion statement is an iterated limit and does not cover general anisotropic residual mobility.
title: Sharp logarithmic sorting-error law for periodically reoriented Brownian colloids
